title: Quipus Rev B four-channel audio review draft

capture.peripheral: ESP32-S3 I2S0 standard TDM master RX; ADC slave TX

firmware_contract.note: This electrical draft does not change existing firmware; four-channel driver and platform profile remain work to implement.
required: Configure ADC AREG internal mode before leaving sleep (P0R2 bit7=1) with 3.3V AVDD.
Enable PLL slave auto-clock operation using ESP BCLK/FSYNC; no independent MCLK needed.
Configure GPI3=PDMDIN2 (P0R44=0x50), GPO3=PDMCLK push-pull (P0R36=0x41). Disable GPIO1 and other unused pin functions.
CH1/2 single-ended AC coupled20kohm input, CH3/4 digitalPDM. P0R60/P0R65=0x28 starting value; P0R70/P0R75=0x40.
PDMDIN2_EDGE=1 (P0R32 bit6) puts U20 LR=GND onCH3 rising-sample and U21 LR=VDD onCH4 falling-sample. Verify by touching/talking to one mic at a time.
Set BIAS_CFG(P0R59)=0x10 for VREF2.75V/MICBIAS3.014V; enable MICBIAS only when capture needed.
Set audio slots0/1/2/3 with32bitwordTDM128BCLKframe and confirm FSYNC/polarity/dataoffset with logic analyser.
Start analog gain0dB and fixed digital gain; raise only after clipping/noise tests. Keep channels separate onSD.
Wait ADC regulator/reference/input settle and Infineon microphone startup>=50ms before retaining samples.
Disable MICBIAS/ADC clock during sleep; mute/ramp amplifier when microphone prompts complete; never play shutdown transient into recording.

notes: Four physical microphones; no guarantee of four speakers or room pickup distance.
External cables initial1m shielded analog, not PDM/USB; ringNC only for Quipus accessory. Do not assume universal TRS/TRRS compatibility.
Do not assign obsolete RevA J4 to long cables. Remove J4/R205/R206; new analoginputs require PCB/firmware revision.
Analog and digital paths have different group delay; preserve separate channels and calibrate before summing/beamforming.
PCB layout, verified footprints, ERC/DRC, audio streaming firmware and bench validation are not supplied as a manufacturing release.
unresolved: Confirm exact SJ1-3533NG footprint/drill geometry using manufacturer top-view drawing and physical sample before routing.
Obtain verified PUI physical +/- pad identity: current published mechanical drawing shows two pads but does not label them. Do not guess pad polarity.
Measure U24 loaded clock10-90% rise/fall<=13ns, duty45-55%, PDM setup>=30ns and hold>=0ns at ADC.
Validate mixed analog/PDM TDM configuration, LR channelmapping, PLLlock, sample timestamps and group-delay calibration on evaluation hardware.
Qualify ESD/pop/plug shorting behaviour at3.5mm input. TVSstandalone clamp voltage is aboveADCabsolute maximum.
Verify effective capacitor values and startup; ADC regulator outputs must not be shorted to supply orloaded externally.
Selected 0805passives stillrequire purchasingmanufacturerpartnumbers/DCbias review; no substitute footprints withoutreview.
